Title: Service Health Notifications added to the Management Portal

Body.Content:
Azure Incident Notifications now displayed within the Azure Management Portal. Customers will see a toast in the Portal for  the following major types of ongoing (i.e. “Active”) incidents, with the option to open a pop-up with more information about the incident.
  • Partial Performance Degradation
  • Partial Service Interruption
  • Full Performance Degradation
  • Full Service Interruption
  • Advisory
Learn more about Azure Service Notifications.
